from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
base=Path('atemp/shared-ownership');before=base/'before-trace';before.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for name in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','volna-trace/src'],text=True).splitlines():
 p=before/Path(name).relative_to('volna-trace');p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 p.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',':'+name]))
(before/'Cargo.toml').write_text('''[package]
name = "volna-trace"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
[workspace]
[dependencies]
vtr = {path = "../../../vtr/vtr-rs"}
anyhow = "1"
bincode = "=1.3.3"

serde = {version = "1", features = ["derive", "rc"]}
[features]
testing = []
''')
for variant,dependency in [('before','../before-trace'),('after','../../../volna-trace')]:
 p=base/variant;p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

name = "shared-ownership-{variant}"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2024"
[workspace]
[dependencies]
volna-trace = {{path = "{dependency}"}}

sha2 = "0.10"
[[bin]]
name = "shared-ownership-{variant}"
path = "../main.rs"
''')
